sources.title: PhysShell/UltraBERT-Embed-150M · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: UltraBERT-Embed-150M is an English text embedding model built on UltraBERT-150M. It maps text to a 768-dimensional vector, takes inputs up to 32K tokens, follows task instructions on the query side, and embeds code as well as text.
